home.heroTitle: Turning community needs into informed development decisions.
home.heroSubtitle: Supporting communities and public institutions with multilingual AI-powered analysis of citizen feedback and infrastructure needs. Connecting voice and text inputs with demographic and public infrastructure data to guide evidence-based public investments.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: A transparent intelligence pipeline that empowers public authorities with structured, evidence-backed community priorities.
home.step1Desc: Citizens submit development needs through voice or text in regional languages. The AI engine standardizes, extracts key issues, and detects urgency without altering original citizen intent.
home.step2Desc: Citizen demand is correlated with regional census demographics, infrastructure indices (road, water, health, electricity), and active public works to identify critical coverage deficits.
home.step3Desc: Public authorities receive transparent priority assessments with clear rationales, affected population estimates, and actionable project specifications to support human decision-making.
home.govTitle: Built on Trust, Transparency & Human Oversight
home.principle1Desc: Designed with open standards to enable deployment across municipal, state, and national bodies.
home.principle2Desc: Ensuring marginalized voices in rural communities communicate effectively in their mother tongue.
home.principle3Desc: Every score is backed by visible weights, verifiable citizen counts, and official infrastructure indices.
home.principle4Desc: Prevents duplicate budgeting by cross-referencing demands against ongoing government public works.
